title: Eleven Minutes at the Gate
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：conversation　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conversation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my grandmother ① struck up a conversation with a woman at a gate neither of them could open, and she said the striking up was the whole of the waiting. The ② conversation, meaning the talk and not the gate, ran eleven minutes and stayed open; conversation, she said, is the only thing at a gate that is judged by how little it needs.

Every ③ conversation on that road had the same weather in it, and the ④ conversation at the end, meaning the one she kept for the bad weeks and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever repeated twice. Conversation, my mother said, is nine parts weather and one part somebody willing to begin; my grandmother said the beginning is the part that fills eleven minutes.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ conversation was the whole of the treaty, meaning the talks and not the chat. The ⑥ conversation, meaning the talks and not any of that, is the only thing in a treaty that everybody reports and nobody hears; conversation, he said, is either something you strike up or the only word that means both a talk and a set of talks. She said the talks are the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ conversation had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the weather. The ⑧ conversation of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in September, was one gate and thirty years of beginning; conversation, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to begin. He said the beginning was never mentioned.

The ⑨ conversation I remember is the one at the end, which she had in 1976 and is still described as the shortest in the county. A ⑩ conversation, my mother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being repeated; every conversation, she said, is a set of talks that has agreed to look like a chat. She said the talks were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 交谈（指那场谈话本身，与那道门相对）
C. 固定搭配：strike up a conversation 搭话、攀谈起来
D. n. 交谈（指那条路上每一次）
E. n. 交谈（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 会谈；谈判（正式会谈，常用复数）
G. n. 交谈（指日记里提到的那一次）
H. n. 交流；会话（抽象总称）

items.q: struck up a conversation with a woman at a gate
The conversation, meaning the talk and not the gate
conversation was the whole of the treaty
the conversation had become a line in a diary
The conversation of the whole thing
A conversation, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: strike up a conversation 意为“搭话、攀谈起来”，1962 年祖母在一道两人都打不开的门口和一位妇女攀谈起来。
conversation 意为“交谈”，指那场谈话本身而不是那道门，它持续了十一分钟，并且一直没有收口。
conversation 指那条路上每一次交谈，每一次都从天气谈起。
conversation 指末尾那一次（她留给那些难熬的日子的那次），是唯一有人复述过两次的。
conversation 意为“会谈、谈判”，父亲说会谈就是那份条约的全部，指的是正式会谈而不是那场闲聊。
conversation 为正式用法，指那些会谈而不是那场闲聊，是条约里人人报道、却无人亲耳听到的东西。
conversation 意为“交谈”，指日记里提到的那一次，到 1970 年这次交谈成了日记里的一行。
conversation 意为“交流、会话”，祖母九月写道，整件事的交流是一道门三十年的开口。
conversation 意为“谈话、交谈”，我记得的是末尾那一次，她 1976 年谈的，至今仍被说成全县最短的。
conversation 为抽象总称，母亲说一场交谈是唯一会因为被复述而变好的东西。
